npm run clean && vue-tsc -b && vite build
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p='dist';const w=d=>{for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const f=d+'/'+e.name;e.isDirectory()&&!e.isSymbolicLink()?w(f):fs.unlinkSync(f)}fs.rmdirSync(d)};fs.existsSync(p)&&w(p);console.log('dist cleaned')"
